scope: Prospective descriptive quality/CPU frontier, not an outcome-selected winner or equivalence test. Same inherited nine SAC policies and online estimator; six frozen horizon/scenario budgets, two cases and fresh paired markets. Common PI-visited states/history benchmark decision and observation/refit costs with one Torch thread. Three exact-setting training replays estimate offline cost because historical timing was not recorded. CPU break-even ignores economic quality and is conditional on deployment acceptance; no guarantee of practical need or universal RL superiority.
